metadata.coaching_cue: Wrap deep overhook into far collar, grab back gi material thumb-up, tuck elbow under chin, hip-escape and push away with outside foot on hip.

text: From Closed Guard Bottom, swim under the opponent's arm to trap an overhook and feed a deep cross-collar grip. Escape hips outside, plant foot on the hip to stop them following, reach over the shoulder to Bunch back-of-gi cloth, rotate the choking wrist THUMB-UP against the carotid, tuck the elbow underneath, and extend legs away for the tap. CTA Cue: Wrap deep overhook into far collar, grab back gi material thumb-up, tuck elbow under chin, hip-escape and push away with outside foot on hip.
title: Caio Terra Closed Guard: Cross-Collar Overhook Choke

metadata.coaching_cue: Establish overhook + collar control; when opponent pushes your choking elbow in, clear your leg over their shoulder and lock high triangle.

text: From Closed Guard Overhook when the opponent defends the cross-collar overhook choke by pushing down on your elbow, immediately thread your ipsilateral leg up and over their free shoulder to lock the triangle. Bridge onto shoulders to pass their arm across your stomach, control your choking shin, cut a 90-degree angle with foot on hip, and squeeze knees with downward hamstring bite. CTA Cue: Establish overhook + collar control; when opponent pushes your choking elbow in, clear your leg over their shoulder and lock high triangle.
title: Caio Terra Closed Guard: Overhook to Triangle Choke Setup

metadata.coaching_cue: Overhook + lapel grip, underhook far leg pulling ear tight to knee, wing hips perpendicular and swing legs toward head (or hook neck for straight armbar if they base).

text: Break posture two-on-one, wrap deep overhook to collar, and underhook the opponent's far leg pulling your head tight to their knee. Wing hips out until perpendicular and swing legs toward their head (never sideways) to come up into top mount/side control (+2 sweep). At t=4655s, if they step up to stop the sweep, switch collar hand behind their tricep and hook the neck for an immediate overhook straight armbar. CTA Cue: Overhook + lapel grip, underhook far leg pulling ear tight to knee, wing hips perpendicular and swing legs toward head (or hook neck for straight armbar if they base).
title: Caio Terra Closed Guard: Overhook Pendulum Sweep & Straight Armbar Dilemma

metadata.coaching_cue: Two-on-one cuff + tricep drag across centerline, hug lat/armpit tight so elbow cannot retract; climb to back control or underhook far leg to pendulum into Mount (+6 pts).

text: Break the opponent's collar or belt grip and drag their tricep across your centerline while hip-escaping slightly to expose the lat. Clamp high over the back to take Back Control (+4 pts), or if the opponent drives back in to square up, scoop/underhook their near or far leg and pendulum your top leg toward their head to land cleanly in Mount (+2 sweep + +4 mount = +6 pts). CTA Cue: Two-on-one cuff + tricep drag across centerline, hug lat/armpit tight so elbow cannot retract; climb to back control or underhook far leg to pendulum into Mount (+6 pts).
title: CTA Closed Guard: 2-on-1 Arm Drag to Back Take or Pendulum Sweep to Mount

metadata.coaching_cue: Cut 90 degrees onto one hip, bite top calf down over opponent's near shoulder with knees pinched (no crossed ankles needed) to kill tripod stack pressure and attack triangle/armbar/sweep.

text: Against heavy tripod stands or stack pressure inside Closed Guard, transition from flat mid-back guard to a 90-degree Shoulder Clamp: overhook or pinch the opponent's near arm, pivot 90 degrees onto your outside hip, and clamp your top shin/calf tightly down over their near shoulder while your bottom knee shields across the hip line. This breaks spine alignment, prevents stacking, and chains directly into side-scissor sweeps, inside-triangle armbars, and omoplatas. CTA Cue: Cut 90 degrees onto one hip, bite top calf down over opponent's near shoulder with knees pinched (no crossed ankles needed) to kill tripod stack pressure and attack triangle/armbar/sweep.
title: CTA Closed Guard: 90-Degree Shoulder Clamp Guard (Anti-Stack & Armlock/Triangle)

metadata.coaching_cue: The moment opponent stands in closed guard, cup both ankles, drop hips low with knees pinched together, drive knees into thighs while pulling heels, and keep heel grips to technical stand into Mount.

text: When the top opponent stands up in Closed Guard to break your ankles, immediately cup behind both of their heels/ankles, open your guard dropping your hips straight to the mat, pinch BOTH knees tight against their hips/inner thighs, and push with your legs while pulling both ankles. Hold their heels after they fall so they cannot scramble up, post one elbow and rear hand with shoulder turned down, and technical-stand into top position or Mount (+2 sweep + +4 mount). CTA Cue: The moment opponent stands in closed guard, cup both ankles, drop hips low with knees pinched together, drive knees into thighs while pulling heels, and keep heel grips to technical stand into Mount.
title: Caio Terra Closed Guard: Standing Double-Ankle (Dummy) Sweep to Mount

metadata.coaching_cue: Rotate palm to strip standing sleeve grip, deep-underhook near ankle pulling ear to knee, post free palm flat near head, drive hips into their knee, and technical-stand to Mount.

text: Against an opponent standing up in Closed Guard, strip their sleeve grip by rotating their palm open, underhook their opposite leg deeply at the ankle/calf, post your free palm on the mat near your head with fingers forward, lift and drive your hips sideways into their knee to collapse their base, and rotate shoulder-down over their legs directly into Mount (+6 cumulative points). CTA Cue: Rotate palm to strip standing sleeve grip, deep-underhook near ankle pulling ear to knee, post free palm flat near head, drive hips into their knee, and technical-stand to Mount.
title: Caio Terra Closed Guard: Standing Grip-Break & Leg-Underhook (Waiter/Muscle) Sweep to Mount

metadata.coaching_cue: Pull knees to chest while flaring both opponent elbows outward whenever they posture; for Kimura (t=3709s), pin wrist to thigh and bring your knee up to trap shoulder instead of sitting up.

text: Closed guard safety depends on breaking posture before the top player stands: flare both of the opponent's elbows wide while pulling your knees toward your chest (t=2080s). At t=3709s, Caio teaches never sitting up prematurely for a Kimura (which lets the opponent posture and straighten their arm); instead, prayer-swim inside, pin their wrist to your thigh, bring your ipsilateral knee up and grab your own shin to lock their shoulder down, then kick back to figure-four your wrist. CTA Cue: Pull knees to chest while flaring both opponent elbows outward whenever they posture; for Kimura (t=3709s), pin wrist to thigh and bring your knee up to trap shoulder instead of sitting up.
title: Caio Terra Closed Guard: Posture Breaks Opening Elbows & No-Sit-Up Kimura

metadata.coaching_cue: Push attacking elbow across centerline, clamp high armpit grip, foot on hip to lock high Pit-Stop bite over shoulder, thumb UP, hug wrist to chest, and curl hamstring downward (works from Closed Diamond too).

text: Break posture, push the opponent's lapel-gripping elbow across centerline with both hands, control the head and clamp deep into the far armpit so the arm cannot pull free. Step on the hip to lock high over the shoulder, rotate opponent's THUMB UP, squeeze knees together without crossing ankles on classic armbar, or finish the Inside-Triangle Straight Armbar (Sankaku Juji-Gatame) with head still trapped inside the diamond by curling the top hamstring downward onto the neck. CTA Cue: Push attacking elbow across centerline, clamp high armpit grip, foot on hip to lock high Pit-Stop bite over shoulder, thumb UP, hug wrist to chest, and curl hamstring downward (works from Closed Diamond too).
title: Caio Terra Closed Guard: Highest-Percentage Armbar & Inside-Triangle Straight Armbar

metadata.coaching_cue: Turn opponent's chin toward your choking hamstring (do not pull straight down early), bridge hips to frame elbow+tricep across stomach, grab your own shin, cut angle, and squeeze knees.

text: Caio Terra's signature Triangle details (t=2352s): place hamstring flush across carotid, turn the opponent's head toward the hamstring rather than pulling chin to chest prematurely, bridge hips high and frame on elbow + tricep (never forearm) to pass the arm across your stomach, grab your choking shin, post foot on hip to cut angle, and lift hips slightly while squeezing knees. Against tight dual-belt grips (t=2627s), control both cuffs, hip out, pin one bicep with lower shin, kick across belly, and lock the triangle. CTA Cue: Turn opponent's chin toward your choking hamstring (do not pull straight down early), bridge hips to frame elbow+tricep across stomach, grab your own shin, cut angle, and squeeze knees.
title: Caio Terra Closed Guard: Triangle Choke Finishing Mechanics & Shin-Pin Entry vs Belt Grips

metadata.coaching_cue: Before hips load past 90 degrees, uncross ankles, flare knees wide, drive dual-collar stiff-arm frames into clavicles while shoulder-walking back, or overhook one arm to lock triangle.

text: Never stay flat holding closed ankles once an opponent swims double underhooks: uncross ankles early, flare knees heavy, stiff-arm both collars into the opponent's clavicles while shoulder-walking backward to flatten their hips, or isolate one sleeve/tricep as they reach under to thread the opposite leg free and snap directly into a Closed Guard Triangle Choke. CTA Cue: Before hips load past 90 degrees, uncross ankles, flare knees wide, drive dual-collar stiff-arm frames into clavicles while shoulder-walking back, or overhook one arm to lock triangle.
title: Caio Terra Closed Guard: Early Frame & Triangle Counter vs Double-Under Stack Pass

metadata.coaching_cue: When opponent postures high, sit up to hip-bump/Kimura threat; wrap chin-cup monkey-grip guillotine keeping head OFF mat, or kick leg over wrist-controlling arm into triangle (t=4167s).

text: When an opponent postures upright out of Closed Guard, sit up onto hand/elbow threatening the Catucada / Hip-Bump Sweep (`Bv5dEguu23g`). If they drive back forward, wrap across the back of the neck into Caio's chin-cup monkey-grip Guillotine keeping your head up off the mat (t=4057s); if they fight your choking wrist (t=4167s), hip-escape wide to that same side and throw your free leg over their defending shoulder into a clean Triangle. CTA Cue: When opponent postures high, sit up to hip-bump/Kimura threat; wrap chin-cup monkey-grip guillotine keeping head OFF mat, or kick leg over wrist-controlling arm into triangle (t=4167s).
title: Caio Terra Closed Guard: Hip-Bump Sweep, Chin-Cup Guillotine & Triangle Follow-Up

metadata.coaching_cue: Secure modified overhook + collar, block posture, pivot hips 90 degrees clearing leg in front of face, sit up controlling waist/hip so opponent cannot roll, and drive chest forward at 45 degrees.

text: From Closed Guard Bottom with a modified overhook, push the opponent's far head/bicep away while pivoting 90 degrees to swing your leg over the trapped shoulder into Omoplata. Immediately reach across the lower back/waist (or block the far knee per Caio Part 1 t=3076s) before sitting up, scoot hips parallel to flatten their shoulder, and lean forward diagonally for the tap or +2 sweep. CTA Cue: Secure modified overhook + collar, block posture, pivot hips 90 degrees clearing leg in front of face, sit up controlling waist/hip so opponent cannot roll, and drive chest forward at 45 degrees.
title: CTA Academy Closed Guard: Omoplata Sweep & Finish from Modified Overhook

metadata.coaching_cue: Blue Belt and above only: trap opponent's elbow crease in your armpit/overhook and cup back of their hand to fold wrist toward forearm while pinching knees.

text: Legal in Adult/Master Blue Belt and above (IBJJF Art. 6.2.2 #12; illegal DQ at White Belt and Juvenile): when the top player posts hands on biceps or chest inside Closed Guard, trap their elbow tightly against your chest/overhook so the arm cannot straighten and compress the back of their hand into a goose-neck wristlock. CTA Cue: Blue Belt and above only: trap opponent's elbow crease in your armpit/overhook and cup back of their hand to fold wrist toward forearm while pinching knees.
title: Rudson Mateus (CTA) Closed Guard: Goose-Neck Wristlock vs Double-Bicep Control (Blue+ Belt)

metadata.coaching_cue: Frame cross-collar/throat + bicep BEFORE shoulders get pinned flat, stay on your bottom hip with top knee-shield active, and pummel underhook to coyote/back-take.

text: In Half Guard Bottom against heavy smash-pass or leg-hugging pressure, Caio emphasizes early skeletal frames rather than muscling from flat on your back: anchor your bottom shoulder, frame across the collar/neck and cross-face bicep before head control is conceded, clear your knee shield inside, and swim the far underhook to come up on a single leg or take the back. CTA Cue: Frame cross-collar/throat + bicep BEFORE shoulders get pinned flat, stay on your bottom hip with top knee-shield active, and pummel underhook to coyote/back-take.
title: Caio Terra Half Guard: Defending and Countering Leg-Hug / Smash Pass with Early Frames

metadata.coaching_cue: Block cross-face bicep first, shoot deep low underhook around far waist/hip, torque trapped ankle outward with bottom hook, and climb behind hips to Back Control.

text: From Half Guard Bottom (also demonstrated in CTA Academy `93PVjltg8aU`), deny the top player's cross-face first, punch a low underhook tight behind their hip/waist keeping your ear glued to their chest so you cannot be Darced or guillotined, switch your half-guard hook to torque their trapped knee inward, and shuck behind their shoulders for +2 sweep or +4 Back Control. CTA Cue: Block cross-face bicep first, shoot deep low underhook around far waist/hip, torque trapped ankle outward with bottom hook, and climb behind hips to Back Control.
title: Caio Terra Half Guard: Underhook to Coyote Dogfight & Back Take

metadata.coaching_cue: Set knee-shield half guard with shallow thumb-down cross-collar grip; bait head-down pass entry, loop free forearm behind neck, and roll under to finish loop choke.

text: From Knee-Shield Half Guard (`7l_aIecS76I` and `RcYLptSeuws`), establish a thumb-down collar grip at collarbone level while framing distance with your knee shield. As the passer drops their head to weave or smash the shield, pull their head under your choking wrist, shoot your second hand deep behind their neck to lock the loop, and spin underneath for a high-percentage choke. CTA Cue: Set knee-shield half guard with shallow thumb-down cross-collar grip; bait head-down pass entry, loop free forearm behind neck, and roll under to finish loop choke.
title: Caio Terra Half Guard: Thumb-Down Loop Choke & Kimura/Armbar Submissions

metadata.coaching_cue: Never push straight up with extended arms; lock inside forearm across near hip crease + top forearm across clavicle, bridge slightly, shrimp hips wide, thread bottom knee across belly to re-guard.

text: From Bottom Side Control (Modern Jiu-Jitsu Part 4), avoid extending your arms into keylock/armbar danger. Anchor your near forearm into the opponent's hip crease and frame your far forearm across their throat/clavicle. Bridge onto one shoulder to create a wedge, hip-escape (shrimp) away, thread your bottom knee across the belt line, and square back to Closed Guard. CTA Cue: Never push straight up with extended arms; lock inside forearm across near hip crease + top forearm across clavicle, bridge slightly, shrimp hips wide, thread bottom knee across belly to re-guard.
title: Caio Terra Side Control Escape: Forearm Hip-Frame & Neck-Frame to Closed Guard Recovery

metadata.coaching_cue: Keep elbows glued to ribs as opponent circles toward North-South, invert/pummel top shin onto bicep, square hips, and snap directly into Triangle Choke.

text: When an opponent passes toward Side Control or circles to North-South (`-814JgFcQ8A`), keep elbows tight to your ribs, frame both hands on biceps/shoulders rather than reaching overhead, bring knees to chest to re-insert a shin shield on the near bicep, and trap head + one arm inside a counter Triangle Choke. CTA Cue: Keep elbows glued to ribs as opponent circles toward North-South, invert/pummel top shin onto bicep, square hips, and snap directly into Triangle Choke.
title: CTA Side Control & North-South Retention: Frame Recovery to Triangle Choke

metadata.coaching_cue: Block near hip + cross-face shoulder first; pop to Knee on Belly (+2 pts held 3s) to force defensive frames, then isolate far arm for Kimura (`IyPwhQ3I2g0`) or Kimura-to-Armbar (`dLo6FohYX_0`).

text: From Top Side Control (`Yd1I9jOTQyo`, `2O5xra-lJtk`, `e-MThXL0jQM`, `IyPwhQ3I2g0`, `dLo6FohYX_0`), pin the opponent's hips before chasing submissions. Pop cleanly to Knee on Belly with far foot posted for +2 IBJJF points; when the bottom player pushes your knee, scoop the near/far arm into Kimura control, step over the head, and finish the Kimura or tight top Armlock. CTA Cue: Block near hip + cross-face shoulder first; pop to Knee on Belly (+2 pts held 3s) to force defensive frames, then isolate far arm for Kimura (`IyPwhQ3I2g0`) or Kimura-to-Armbar (`dLo6FohYX_0`).
title: CTA Side Control Top: Hip Control, Knee on Belly (+2), Kimura & Spinning Armlock

metadata.coaching_cue: Brace stacked hands/forearm on hip line and snake shoulders upward so opponent stays low on waist; turn onto one hip, wedge knee inside with elbow tight to ribs, and recover Half/Closed Guard.

text: Caio Terra's primary Mount Escape (Modern Jiu-Jitsu Part 2 `xp6xTVThYAo` t=82s & t=467s): never let the top player climb into high mount. Place one forearm across their hip line reinforced by the second hand and snake your upper body backward until their knees sit low near your hips. Turn onto your side, trap their ankle or push their knee with elbow tight to your ribs, slide your bottom knee through into Half Guard, and square to Closed Guard. CTA Cue: Brace stacked hands/forearm on hip line and snake shoulders upward so opponent stays low on waist; turn onto one hip, wedge knee inside with elbow tight to ribs, and recover Half/Closed Guard.
title: Caio Terra Mount Escape: Low Hip-Frame Snake & Elbow-Knee Escape to Guard

metadata.coaching_cue: When opponent hugs head or leans chest-low in mount, trap same-side arm above elbow + block same-side foot, bridge diagonally over shoulder into Closed Guard; vs Mount Armbar (t=873s), clasp rear thigh/gi.

text: From Bottom Mount when the opponent wraps your head (t=190s) or posts low (t=267s), trap one arm at the tricep/elbow so they cannot post, block their ipsilateral foot with yours, and bridge high over your shoulder into top Closed Guard. Against a Mount Armbar (t=873s), answer-the-phone/clasp your attacked arm, hug behind their thigh or pant knee, and bridge into them to stack and clear head. CTA Cue: When opponent hugs head or leans chest-low in mount, trap same-side arm above elbow + block same-side foot, bridge diagonally over shoulder into Closed Guard; vs Mount Armbar (t=873s), clasp rear thigh/gi.
title: Caio Terra Mount Escape: Trap-and-Roll (Upa) & Mount Armbar Defense

metadata.coaching_cue: Pin wrist or pry elbow across centerline to slide knees high into armpits; feed deep thumb-in cross-collar choke (t=3072s) or pivot to S-Mount (`xp6xTVThYAo` t=3576s / `mhuXWOfEzBM`) for zero-space armbar.

text: From Top Mount (+4 pts), systematically walk knees into the opponent's armpits (High Mount) by attacking keylock/cross-face grips. At t=3072s, feed a deep four-finger collar grip, open the chin with your forearm, set the second grip thumb-in or grab shoulder cloth, and drop elbows to the mat for the Cross-Collar Choke. At t=3576s (and `mhuXWOfEzBM` vs frames), slide into tight S-Mount keeping weight heavy on chest before stepping delicately over the face for the Armbar. CTA Cue: Pin wrist or pry elbow across centerline to slide knees high into armpits; feed deep thumb-in cross-collar choke (t=3072s) or pivot to S-Mount (`xp6xTVThYAo` t=3576s / `mhuXWOfEzBM`) for zero-space armbar.
title: Caio Terra Top Mount: Walking to High Mount, Cross-Collar Choke & S-Mount Armbar

metadata.coaching_cue: Keep elbows glued inside knee-hip gap and chin tucked; tuck near hip/shoulder underneath immediately to re-lock Closed Guard (0 pts conceded), or trap opponent's tricep and sit-out/roll (`xp6xTVThYAo` t=1731s).

text: In Bottom Turtle (Part 2 `xp6xTVThYAo` t=1272s, t=1619s, t=1731s), never stay frozen on hands and knees leaving space between elbows and knees where the top player inserts hooks (+4 pts) or collar grips. Seal elbows inside thighs while protecting your lapel; tuck your inside shoulder and hip underneath to roll smoothly back into Closed Guard (0 pts / 0 adv conceded), or clamp their body-lock tricep above the elbow (t=1731s 2006 Worlds reversal) and roll them across your shoulder. CTA Cue: Keep elbows glued inside knee-hip gap and chin tucked; tuck near hip/shoulder underneath immediately to re-lock Closed Guard (0 pts conceded), or trap opponent's tricep and sit-out/roll (`xp6xTVThYAo` t=1731s).
title: Caio Terra Bottom Turtle: Protecting Hooks/Neck, Hip-Roll to Closed Guard & Sit-Out Reversal

metadata.coaching_cue: Never jump a loose arm-out gi guillotine from front headlock; stay behind elbows keeping weight on opponent's hips, establish seat-belt/lapel grip, Tilt toward top hook (`xp6xTVThYAo` t=4358s) for +4 Back Control or Darce (`RUbY8UvTgbA`).

text: From Top Turtle / Front Headlock in the Gi (`xp6xTVThYAo` t=4067s & t=4358s), Caio warns against pulling guard for low-percentage arm-out gi guillotines (which forfeits top position). Keep heavy chest pressure behind their shoulder/hip line, feed collar or seat-belt control, insert the near/top hook and pull them diagonally into your lap to secure the second hook (+4 Back Control), or thread the Darce Choke (`RUbY8UvTgbA`) / Clock Choke when they shell flat. CTA Cue: Never jump a loose arm-out gi guillotine from front headlock; stay behind elbows keeping weight on opponent's hips, establish seat-belt/lapel grip, Tilt toward top hook (`xp6xTVThYAo` t=4358s) for +4 Back Control or Darce (`RUbY8UvTgbA`).
title: Caio Terra Top Turtle: Hip-Pin Control, Single-Hook Drag to Back Control & Darce/Clock Choke

metadata.coaching_cue: Keep chest glued to upper back with seat-belt (over-shoulder choking arm, under-armpit control arm) and heels uncrossed; stretch top lapel thumb-in under chin for Sliding Collar / Bow-and-Arrow (`akOd9hKZgC8`) or switch to Back Armbar (t=4825s).

text: From Back Control (+4 pts, `xp6xTVThYAo` t=4437s, t=4649s, t=4825s, t=4968s plus `9NHz4FTfJ-k` and `akOd9hKZgC8`), never cross ankles low between the opponent's legs (vulnerable to ankle lock). Maintain tight chest-to-scapula connection, open and feed the deep top collar under the chin while controlling the far lapel or pant knee for Sliding Collar / Bow-and-Arrow Choke, or peel two-on-one wrist defense and throw top leg over the face into a Back Armlock (t=4825s). CTA Cue: Keep chest glued to upper back with seat-belt (over-shoulder choking arm, under-armpit control arm) and heels uncrossed; stretch top lapel thumb-in under chin for Sliding Collar / Bow-and-Arrow (`akOd9hKZgC8`) or switch to Back Armbar (t=4825s).
title: Caio Terra Back Control: Uncrossed-Hook Retention, Sliding Collar/Bow-and-Arrow & RNC/Armbar

metadata.coaching_cue: Protect neck two-on-one on choking wrist first (or peel bottom lapel grip at t=2154s), clear bottom hook, and slide BOTH shoulders flat to the mat on the underhook side to turn into Closed Guard (`IWvJyHhd9NI`).

text: From Back Defense (`xp6xTVThYAo` t=1849s, t=1936s, t=2154s and CTA `IWvJyHhd9NI`), immediately fight the choking hand first (tucking ear to bicep at t=2025s or stripping the secondary collar hand at t=2154s so the choke loses anchor), shift hips over the opponent's bottom hook, put your head and outside shoulder flat on the mat on the non-choking side, and turn directly into Closed Guard. CTA Cue: Protect neck two-on-one on choking wrist first (or peel bottom lapel grip at t=2154s), clear bottom hook, and slide BOTH shoulders flat to the mat on the underhook side to turn into Closed Guard (`IWvJyHhd9NI`).
title: Caio Terra Back Escape: Blocking Second Hook, Collar-Grip Strip & Shoulder-to-Mat Escape

metadata.coaching_cue: Sit upright with head forward of hips (never flat on lower back); hit Collar Drag (t=528s), Hook Sweep with underhook/overhook (t=320s), or Caio's Unnoticed Loop Choke (t=400s).

text: In Butterfly Guard (Modern Jiu-Jitsu Part 3 `VWzT1iUMvEc` t=88s-610s), keep forehead ahead of hips and hands winning inside tie-ups. Snap cross-collar + tricep for a Collar Drag to Turtle/Back (t=528s), elevate with sticky instep hook while pulling sleeve under you for the classic Hook Sweep (t=320s), or catch head-down passers in Caio's Unnoticed Loop Choke (t=400s). CTA Cue: Sit upright with head forward of hips (never flat on lower back); hit Collar Drag (t=528s), Hook Sweep with underhook/overhook (t=320s), or Caio's Unnoticed Loop Choke (t=400s).
title: Caio Terra Butterfly Guard: Head-Forward Posture, Hook Sweep, Collar Drag & Loop Choke

metadata.coaching_cue: Drive opponent flat onto their back first with elbows tight to hips and live toes; weave arm under top leg to clear bottom hook (t=1747s) or knee-slice middle vs underhook (t=2046s).

text: Passing Butterfly Guard (`VWzT1iUMvEc` t=1596s, t=1747s, t=2046s and `_xM_Nep-Tso`): neutralize seated leverage by driving the opponent's shoulders flat to the mat with head low and elbows glued to hips. Step/tripod to extract one hook, lace under the top leg to pin knees sideways into Side Control (+3 pts), or counter their deep underhook by slicing your knee straight through the middle. CTA Cue: Drive opponent flat onto their back first with elbows tight to hips and live toes; weave arm under top leg to clear bottom hook (t=1747s) or knee-slice middle vs underhook (t=2046s).
title: Caio Terra Butterfly Guard Passing: Flattening Hips, Leg-Weave & Underhook Counter Pass

metadata.coaching_cue: Maintain three points of contact (ankle cuff + collar/sleeve + active shin/RDLR hook); invert/kiss-the-dragon to Back Control (`K77D_63NfaQ`), hit Tripod Sweep (`wX4jNormznA`), or Omoplata (`MSggMpW2Pkk`).

text: Against standing passers in Open Guard (`bMPn3KQVvyA`, `K77D_63NfaQ`, `wX4jNormznA`, `MSggMpW2Pkk`), anchor heel/ankle control before setting Reverse De La Riva or Collar-and-Sleeve frames. Off-balance immediately with Tripod/Sickle sweeps (+2 pts), thread Collar-Sleeve Omoplata when they tuck their elbow in combat base, or spin underneath RDLR to take Back Control (+4 pts). CTA Cue: Maintain three points of contact (ankle cuff + collar/sleeve + active shin/RDLR hook); invert/kiss-the-dragon to Back Control (`K77D_63NfaQ`), hit Tripod Sweep (`wX4jNormznA`), or Omoplata (`MSggMpW2Pkk`).
title: Caio Terra Open Guard: Reverse De La Riva Back Take, Collar-Sleeve Omoplata & Tripod Sweep

metadata.coaching_cue: Wrap wrist blade high under Achilles tendon with elbow pulled far back behind ribs, pinch knees without reaping across knee line, turn outward onto choking shoulder, and arch chest.

text: The signature Caio Terra Straight Footlock (`M_hPR8tLPNU` and `mu-U87mdETU`): legal at all adult/master belt ranks including White Belt so long as your outside foot stays cleanly on the hip without reaping across the centerline and you turn outward toward the attacked foot side (IBJJF Art. 6.2.2 #13). CTA Cue: Wrap wrist blade high under Achilles tendon with elbow pulled far back behind ribs, pinch knees without reaping across knee line, turn outward onto choking shoulder, and arch chest.
title: Caio Terra Straight Ankle / De La Riva Footlock (White-Belt Legal Outward Finish)

metadata.coaching_cue: Control safe outside distance until grips land first; pin one pant cuff + collar to circle past legs (t=988s), redirect foot across hip (t=1069s), drive knee-cut (t=1150s), or dump sideways off double-unders (t=1321s).

text: Caio Terra's Standing Pass system (`VWzT1iUMvEc` t=726s-1477s): maintain safe distance outside seated guard until you dictate grips; control pant cuff at ankle + collar to flank into Side Control (+3 pts), push the ankle across into Leg-Drag when they follow (t=1069s), drive elbow-knee connected Knee-Cut when grips get stripped (t=1150s), or convert stalled Double-Unders by shucking legs sideways (t=1321s). CTA Cue: Control safe outside distance until grips land first; pin one pant cuff + collar to circle past legs (t=988s), redirect foot across hip (t=1069s), drive knee-cut (t=1150s), or dump sideways off double-unders (t=1321s).

metadata.coaching_cue: Establish collar + four-finger outside cuff grip FIRST (never jump guard at White Belt!), plant your foot squarely on the SLEEVE-CONTROLLED hip, pull forward onto toes, and sit close under your heel into Closed Guard.
